sentences.text:
THIS MFA IS FILED U/SEC.54(1) OF THE LAND  ACQUISITION ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DTD  18.01.2020 PASSED IN LAC.NO.313/2014 ON THE FILE OF THE  SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE FIRST CLASS,
 ATHANI, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.15,95,523.79.

THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE  COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:10221  MFA No. 101694 of 2020  ORDER Vide order dated 01.09.2023 a week's time was granted to pay the deficit court fee and it was made clear in the said order that in case the deficit court fee is not paid, the appeal will be dismissed for non-prosecution.
Till today, the deficit court fee is not paid.
No grounds are made out to grant the adjournment.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
It is stated that interim order was granted by this Court subject to condition that the appellant shall deposit 60% of the amount awarded by the Reference Court.
The said amount is said to be deposited before the Reference Court.
Since the appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution, the interim order does not operate in favour of the appellant.
